title: Pharmaceutical market data for frontier markets | Nazryx
description: Know what's open before you commit. Nazryx builds market data across 14 frontier markets and reads it against your portfolio, product by product.

sections.title: Know what's open
sections.lede: Frontier markets are not opaque. They are unread. We build the data, read it against your portfolio, and turn it into decisions: where to enter, with what, and at what price.

items.title: Read, don't search
items.text: Openings only show when a whole market is read, not when one product is searched.

items.title: Shelves beat surveys
items.text: What actually sells, and at what price, is on the shelf. That is where we look.

items.title: Fresh beats thorough
items.text: A market changes every week. We keep the read current, not filed.

items.title: Competition
items.text: Who already sells your products, from where, and how crowded each line is.

items.title: Price
items.text: What your products sell for, and where your price lands against the competition.

items.title: Demand
items.text: What actually moves, and what the state buys, round by round.

items.title: Buyers and partners
items.text: Who can sell your products, judged by what they really carry. 300+ distributors profiled.

sections.title: From one product

items.title: Market read
items.text: Your whole catalogue against one or more markets: open, thin or crowded, line by line. 2–3 weeks.

items.title: Product profile
items.text: Two pages per product: competitors, packs and prices, market structure, then the registration and launch plan.

items.title: Market file
items.text: One country in full: market size, buyers, chains, prices by producer country, doctors and registration routes.

items.title: Monitoring
items.text: New registrations, lapses, competitors and tenders in your categories, reported weekly.

sections.lede: Four ways to use our data, from one product to a whole market.

items.title: Which market?
items.text: Where your categories are open, and where they are crowded.

items.title: Which products?
items.text: The lines with room for one more source, ranked.

items.title: At what price?
items.text: Where your price lands against Indian, Western and local brands.

items.title: Through which route?
items.text: National or regional registration, and how long each takes.

items.title: Collect
items.text: Our own data, built and kept current market by market.

items.title: Match
items.text: Your portfolio matched product by product, by form and strength.

items.title: Score
items.text: Each line rated open, thin or crowded, with the reason in writing.

sections.title: Every market we serve,
sections.lede: Pick a region to see our view of it.

sections.title: Request a market read.
sections.text: Send your product list and your target markets. We read them for you.
